resources.string: Dictate into any app. Speech is turned into text on this phone. The app has no internet permission, so nothing you say can leave the device.
Loading the speech model (first use only)…
Didn\'t catch that. Tap the mic and try again.
Something went wrong. Please try again.
Microphone access needed. Open the app to allow it.
Couldn\'t open the microphone. Another app may be using it.
The text box closed, so your dictation was saved in History.
Turn on \"Offline Voice\" in the list. Android will warn that keyboards can see what you type; this one has no internet access, so it can\'t send anything anywhere.
Optional. You can also switch any time with the keyboard icon at the bottom of the screen.
Another keyboard is active. Use the keyboard icon at the bottom of the screen, or tap below.
Tap here, switch to Offline Voice, then tap the mic.
Say \"comma\", \"full stop\", \"question mark\", \"new line\" or \"new paragraph\".
Stores your last 50 dictations on this phone so you can copy them again. Turning it off deletes them.
Names and terms to spell correctly, separated by commas.
e.g. Oracle, OTC, AR aging, vendor master
Nothing yet. Tap an item to copy it.

Speech model: %1$s (Whisper, English).
Engine: whisper.cpp (MIT licence).
Internet access: none. The app does not request it.
Audio is kept in memory only and discarded after each dictation.
